text:
Gerardo, who grieves over his repeated error,
though soon he grieve amid a thousand horrors,
deserves the sun of eternal splendors,
in recompense for night's oblivion.

But whoever does not break the laws of sense
asks heaven's favor in vain;
the mighty aid that overcomes our errors
is often late when one must be lost.

What matters if I say that I am sailing
toward the port that disillusion leads to,
if my soul now hides its idols?

But, my lord, if error is blind,
it knew how to lose its sight—and that was harm,
for when it weeps, it opens its eyes wider.

translation.title: Gerardo, Who Grieves over His Repeated Error
